items.title: On the Null Distribution of a Non-Parametric Test for the Bivariate Two-Sample Problem
items.container: Journal of the Royal Statistical Society Series B: Statistical Methodology
items.abstract: Summary A non-parametric test criterion U for the bivariate two-sample problem has been proposed by Mardia (1967). It is shown in Mardia (1968) that a two-sample test on a circle proposed by Wheeler and Watson (1964) has the same null distribution as that of U. In view of this additional application, we extend the table of critical values of U given in Mardia (1967), give a new approximation to the null distribution and compare it with the approximations given in Mardia (1967). We also apply the U-test to a geological problem.

items.title: On the eigenvalues associated with the limit null distribution of the Epps-Pulley test of normality
items.abstract: Abstract The Shapiro–Wilk test (SW) and the Anderson–Darling test (AD) turned out to be strong procedures for testing for normality. They are joined by a class of tests for normality proposed by Epps and Pulley that, in contrast to SW and AD, have been extended by Baringhaus and Henze to yield easy-to-use affine invariant and universally consistent tests for normality in any dimension. The limit null distribution of the Epps–Pulley test involves a sequences of eigenvalues of a certain integral operator induced by the covariance kernel of a Gaussian process.
